'''Omonoia Aradippou''' ({{Langx|el|Ομόνοια Αραδίππου}}) is a [[Cyprus|Cypriot]] professional [[Association football|football]] club based in the Municipality of [[Aradippou]], a settlement in the outskirts of the city of [[Larnaca]].

The club was founded on 4 April 1929<ref name="Establishment date">{{cite web |last1=Theodorou |first1=Tasos |title=BALLA SPECIAL: 90 χρόνια "Περιστέρια"! "Και μπαμ και μπουμ"! (pics&vids) |url=https://balla.com.cy/2019/04/03/balla-special-90-chronia-peristeria-kai-mpam-kai-mpoym-pics-amp-vids/ |website=www.balla.com.cy |publisher=Balla Cyprus |access-date=3 April 2019 |language=el |archive-date=3 April 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190403193151/https://balla.com.cy/2019/04/03/balla-special-90-chronia-peristeria-kai-mpam-kai-mpoym-pics-amp-vids/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> and they were the [[Champions]] of the [[Cypriot Second Division]] for the season 2023–24. For the season 2025-26 they will compete again in the [[Cypriot First Division]].

They have competed in the [[Cypriot First Division]] several times in the past. The [[Cypriot First Division 1995-96|1995–1996 season]] was their most recent one in the [[Cypriot First Division|First Division]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Ομόνοια Αραδίππου, Ερμής Αραδίππου: "Ταξίδι στο χρόνο" {{!}} Gazzetta |url=https://www.gazzetta.gr/football/protathlima-cyta/2330091/omonoia-aradippoy-ermis-aradippoy-taxidi-sto-hrono |access-date=2024-05-03 |website=www.gazzetta.gr |language=el}}</ref>"}}
